note: The five proposed sample screens under docs/audits/primitives-usage/proposed/. Build them with `PRIMITIVES_USAGE_PROPOSED_OUT=~/.cache/primitives-usage/dist/proposed npx vite build -c docs/audits/primitives-usage/proposed/vite.config.mjs`.

screens.name: list
screens.why: Recommendation 1 and 3: a list row whose title wraps, set in pointer-driven type, with one metadata line and one control. Compare reader/library, stockade/items, jobs/roles.

screens.name: status
screens.why: Recommendation 4: state by icon and word in the status tokens, problems first. Compare watchtower/dashboard.

screens.name: detail
screens.why: Recommendations 2, 5 and 6: a visible title, the text before the controls, 44px segments, the action in the thumb zone. Compare ops-hub-web/issue.

screens.name: plan
screens.why: Recommendation 4: progress in words and a bar, done steps without a tint. Compare shell/plan.

screens.name: empty
screens.why: An empty state that says what to do next, with the action in reach. Compare jobs/roles' 'Pick a role'.
